name: forge-agent-cli
description: forge ∞ — autonomous software engineering intelligence. Zero dependencies, pure Node, direct-to-provider. v99 loopwise (the agency release: THE STOP FIX — the direct one-shot agent no longer halts dead at its step budget: while a run is PRODUCTIVE (fresh writes, passing checks, diverse tool use, no signature loop) its step AND tool-call budgets auto-extend in bounded increments up to the same hard caps, with visible step_budget_extended events and honest INCOMPLETE+checkpoint when it stalls — while the meta-side segment table doubles its bases so a healthy run is no longer interrupted every ~25 steps; THE REVIEWER — codereview.js gives every mutating segment ONE bounded read-only review of the ACTUAL change (working diff vs HEAD, LSP diagnostics, failing ledger evidence, secret/smell scan of ADDED lines): deterministic findings stand alone, a reviewer agent pass adds strict-JSON findings, blockers become required actions that drive repair, CODE_REVIEW_* events persist, and the v94 stale-required-action deadlock is fixed (recurring actions are re-derived per attempt, never sticky); THE FIXER — repairSegment now receives a structured DEFECT REPORT (live LSP diagnostics, failing verification records, the read-only verifier's own report) plus a deterministic autofix fast path: lint/format-class failures get the project's OWN allowlisted, shellguard-safe formatter ONCE before any LLM tokens are spent, with ledger evidence either way; THE PLANNER — plancritique.js is the quality gate the planner lacked: coverage vs the objective's own terms, granularity, verification-step presence, read-only balance — one bounded revision pass when majors exist, adopted only if it re-validates AND beats the original score; REACH — a curated MCP catalog (100 ranked GitHub-backed servers, forge mcp add/catalog/remove, secrets never invented) and a skill registry (best GitHub skill repos with ready raw URLs, forge skill search/recommend) plus 4 new bundled skills (code-reviewer, perf-tuning, api-design, data-migration); DELIVERY — gitship.pr=gh opens real pull requests through the user's OWN gh CLI (passthrough, never a forge-held token, consent-gated like push)) on v98 shipwise.
